invariants.rationale: If b is not zero, the result should be exactly a divided by b using integer division, otherwise division would have thrown.
If b is zero, integer division is impossible and the method returns Integer.MIN_VALUE as special sentinel.
The result is Integer.MIN_VALUE if and only if b is zero.
Always true for any int, highlighting that when b == 0, no division was performed.
Trivially true but valid. (Included as per instruction to provide up to 5).
